description: This file defines the 'Silo' class, which is a core component of the Orleans distributed virtual actor framework. It manages the lifecycle, startup, shutdown, and internal services of a silo node within an Orleans cluster. The class includes methods for initializing, starting, stopping, and disposing of the silo, as well as handling internal system states and logging. It also references various external components such as message centers, grain factories, and lifecycle participants.

classes.name: Silo
classes.description: Represents an Orleans silo node, managing its lifecycle, services, and communication within the cluster.

classes.name: LifecycleSchedulingSystemTarget
classes.description: A dummy system target used for scheduling lifecycle-related tasks within the silo.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Starts the silo asynchronously, initializing necessary components and lifecycle.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Gracefully stops the silo, ensuring proper shutdown of services and messaging.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of the silo, invoking stop procedures.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Synchronously disposes of the silo, invoking stop procedures.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Registers lifecycle participants for various stages of the silo's lifecycle.
